# OpenCV.js

`opencv.js` is the official OpenCV.js 4.13.0 build (WASM inlined), downloaded
unmodified from https://docs.opencv.org/4.13.0/opencv.js.

It is loaded on demand by the Document Scanner tool's web worker
(`components/tools/document-scanner/scanner.worker.ts`) and is not part of
the main bundle.
